A few reminders about paperwork queues
It is for people travelling soon

Paperwork Queue Notice

Travelers should bring complete animal travel papers to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before they head to boarding. Clear records help us move each case through review with care and keep the welcome team ready for a smooth handoff.

If something looks missing, we will raise it through the normal step by step review and explain the next action in plain words. Please keep pets and carriers close while you wait, and have supporting documents ready so we can help you without delay. We treat every journey as a shared responsibility and aim to keep the process calm and steady.

For any further help, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
